# Use S4 to create new class
## 1. Create a sparse matrix class: bis620_sparse_matrix
```{r create class-bis620_sparse_matrix}

setClass(Class = "bis620_sparse_matrix",
         slots = list(i = "numeric",
                      j = "numeric",
                      x = "numeric"),
         )

```

## 2. Add arithmetic operators
### 2.1 Add arithmetic operators `+`
```{r operator +}

setGeneric("+")

setMethod(
  f = "+",
  signature = c(e1 = "bis620_sparse_matrix", e2 = "bis620_sparse_matrix"),
  definition = function(e1, e2){
    a <- data.frame(i = e1@i, j = e1@j, x = e1@x)
    b <- data.frame(i = e2@i, j = e2@j, x = e2@x)

    if (max(a$i) != max(b$i) || max(a$j) != max(b$j)){
      stop("Two matrices have different dimentions.")
    }

    cc <- merge(a, b, by = c("i", "j"), all = TRUE,
                suffixes = c("1", "2"))
    cc$x1[is.na(cc$x1)] <- 0
    cc$x2[is.na(cc$x2)] <- 0
    cc$x <- cc$x1 + cc$x2
    Matrix::sparseMatrix(i = cc$i, j = cc$j, x = cc$x)
  }
)

setMethod(
  f = "+",
  signature = c(e1 = "bis620_sparse_matrix", e2 = "matrix" ),
  definition = function(e1, e2){
    a <- data.frame(i = e1@i, j = e1@j, x = e1@x)
    b <- data.frame(i = rep(1:nrow(e2), ncol(e2)),
                    j = rep(1:nrow(e2), each = ncol(e2)),
                    x = sapply(e2, function(i)i)
                    )

    if (max(a$i) != max(b$i) || max(a$j) != max(b$j)){
      stop("Two matrices have different dimentions.")
    }

    cc <- merge(a, b, by = c("i", "j"), all = TRUE,
                suffixes = c("1", "2"))
    cc$x1[is.na(cc$x1)] <- 0
    cc$x2[is.na(cc$x2)] <- 0
    cc$x <- cc$x1 + cc$x2
    Matrix::sparseMatrix(i = cc$i, j = cc$j, x = cc$x)
  }
)

setMethod(
  f = "+",
  signature = c(e1 = "dgeMatrix", e2 = "bis620_sparse_matrix"),
  definition = function(e1, e2){
    a <- data.frame(i = rep(1:nrow(e1), ncol(e1)),
                    j = rep(1:nrow(e1), each = ncol(e1)),
                    x = sapply(e1, function(i)i),
    b <- data.frame(i = e2@i, j = e2@j, x = e2@x)
    )

    if (max(a$i) != max(b$i) || max(a$j) != max(b$j)){
      stop("Two matrices have different dimentions.")
    }

    cc <- merge(a, b, by = c("i", "j"), all = TRUE,
                suffixes = c("1", "2"))
    cc$x1[is.na(cc$x1)] <- 0
    cc$x2[is.na(cc$x2)] <- 0
    cc$x <- cc$x1 + cc$x2
    Matrix::sparseMatrix(i = cc$i, j = cc$j, x = cc$x)
  }
)

setMethod(
  f = "+",
  signature = c(e1 = "bis620_sparse_matrix", e2 = "dgCMatrix" ),
  definition = function(e1, e2){
    a <- data.frame(i = e1@i, j = e1@j, x = e1@x)
    b <- as.data.frame(summary(e2))

    if (max(a$i) != e2@Dim[1] || max(a$j) != e2@Dim[2]){
      stop("Two matrices have different dimentions.")
    }

    cc <- merge(a, b, by = c("i", "j"), all = TRUE,
                suffixes = c("1", "2"))
    cc$x1[is.na(cc$x1)] <- 0
    cc$x2[is.na(cc$x2)] <- 0
    cc$x <- cc$x1 + cc$x2
    Matrix::sparseMatrix(i = cc$i, j = cc$j, x = cc$x)
  }
)

```

### 2.5 Add arithmetic operators `%*%` 
```{r operator %*%}

setGeneric(
  "%*%"
)

setMethod(
  f = "%*%",
  signature = c(x = "bis620_sparse_matrix", y = "matrix"),
  definition = function(x, y){

    if (max(x@i) != ncol(y)){
      stop("The dimensions of two matrices don't match.")
    }

    a <- sparseMatrix(i = x@i, j = x@j, x = x@x,
                      dims = c(max(x@i), max(x@j)))

    cc <- matrix(0L, nrow = max(x@i), ncol = ncol(y))
    for (m in 1:nrow(a)){
      for (n in 1:ncol(y)){
        cc[m,n] <-  sum(a[m,] * y[,n])
      }
    }

    cc <- data.frame(i = rep(1:nrow(cc), ncol(cc)),
                    j = rep(1:nrow(cc), each = ncol(cc)),
                    x = sapply(cc, function(i)i)
    )

    cc <- sparseMatrix(i = cc$i, j = cc$j, x = cc$x, dims = c(max(x@i), ncol(y)))
  }
)


setMethod(
  f = "%*%",
  signature = c(x = "dgCMatrix", y = "bis620_sparse_matrix"),
  definition = function(x, y){

    if (nrow(x) != max(y@j)){
      stop("The dimensions of two matrices don't match.")
    }

    b <- sparseMatrix(i = y@i, j = y@j, x = y@x,
                      dims = c(max(y@i), max(y@j)))

    x %*% b
  }
)


setMethod(
  f = "%*%",
  signature = c(x = "bis620_sparse_matrix", y = "dgCMatrix"),
  definition = function(x, y){

    if (max(x@i) != ncol(y)){
      stop("The dimensions of two matrices don't match.")
    }

    a <- sparseMatrix(i = x@i, j = x@j, x = x@x,
                      dims = c(max(x@i), max(x@j)))

    cc <- matrix(NA, nrow = max(x@i), ncol = ncol(y))
    for (m in 1:nrow(a)){
      for (n in 1:ncol(y)){
        cc[m,n] <-  sum(a[m,] * y[,n])
      }
    }
    cc <- Matrix(cc)
  }
)


setMethod(
  f = "%*%",
  signature = c(x = "bis620_sparse_matrix", y = "bis620_sparse_matrix"),
  definition = function(x, y){

    if (max(x@i) != max(y@j)){
      stop("The dimensions of two matrices don't match.")
    }

    a <- sparseMatrix(i = x@i, j = x@j, x = x@x,
                      dims = c(max(x@i), max(x@j)))
    b <- sparseMatrix(i = y@i, j = y@j, x = y@x,
                      dims = c(max(y@i), max(y@j)))

    cc <- matrix(NA, nrow = max(x@i), ncol = max(y@j))
    for (m in 1:nrow(a)){
      for (n in 1:ncol(b)){
        cc[m,n] <-  sum(a[m,] * b[,n])
      }
    }
    cc <- Matrix(cc)
  }
)


```

### 2.6 Add function t() to transpose bis620_sparse_matrix
```{r operator t}

setGeneric(
  "t"
)

setMethod(
  f = "t",
  signature = c(x = "bis620_sparse_matrix"),
  definition = function(x){
    sparseMatrix(i = x@j, j = x@i, x = x@x)
  }
)
```

## 3. Test the new class

```{r tests, results='hold'}

x1 <- new("bis620_sparse_matrix",
          i = c(1, 2, 5, 6),
          j = c(2, 2, 6, 1),
          x = c(4.3, 5.6, 7, 10))

set.seed(1)

x2 <- matrix(rnorm(36), ncol = 6)

library(Matrix)

set.seed(1)

x3 <- Matrix(rnorm(36), ncol = 6)
set.seed(1)

x4 <- sparseMatrix(
  i = c(1, 1, 3, 6),
  j = c(2, 3, 5, 1),
  x = c(4.3, 5.6, 7, 10),
  dims = c(6, 6)
)


# Test that the following are correct:
x1 + x1
t(x1) %*% x1
x1 %*% x1
x1 + t(x2)
x1 %*% x2
x3 + x1
x3 %*% x3
x1 + x4
x1 %*% x4


# Test the class of results
library(testthat)
test_that(
  "The new class matrix set up successfully",{
    expect_s4_class(x1+ x1, "dgCMatrix")
  }
)

test_that(
  "The new class matrix set up successfully",{
    expect_s4_class(t(x1) %*% x1, "dgCMatrix")
  }
)

test_that(
  "The new class matrix set up successfully",{
    expect_s4_class(x1 %*% x1, "dgCMatrix")
  }
)

test_that(
  "The new class matrix set up successfully",{
    expect_s4_class(x1 + t(x2), "dgCMatrix")
  }
)

test_that(
  "The new class matrix set up successfully",{
    expect_s4_class(x1 %*% x2, "dgCMatrix")
  }
)

test_that(
  "The new class matrix set up successfully",{
    expect_s4_class(x3 + x1, "dgCMatrix")
  }
)

test_that(
  "The new class matrix set up successfully",{
    expect_s4_class(x3 + x3, "dgeMatrix")
  }
)

test_that(
  "The new class matrix set up successfully",{
    expect_s4_class(x1 + x4, "dgCMatrix")
  }
)

test_that(
  "The new class matrix set up successfully",{
    expect_s4_class(x1 %*% x4, "dtCMatrix")
  }
)



```

# Final homework proposal

Integrate what we have learned this semester:  
* Clean and explore a data set;  
* Visualize the data set using interactive graphics；  
* If needed, create new class to holds variables in the data set;  
* Document and test the functions created in the above process;<br>
* Add the result into `bis620` package.
